---
title: "📷 Light Preserver Archive"
subtitle: "DIGITAL & ANALOG PHOTOGRAPH GALLERY"
page-layout: full
---

```{=html}
<style>
.page-columns .content, 
main.content, 
#quarto-document-content, 
.quarto-title-block, 
#title-block-header {
  max-width: 1400px !important; 
  width: 100% !important;
  margin-left: auto !important;
  margin-right: auto !important;
}

/* 상단 수평 제어 필터 허브 */
.gallery-filter-hero-container {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.8rem;
  margin: 2rem auto 3rem auto;
  padding-bottom: 2rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e8e8ed;
  max-width: 850px; 
  width: 100%;
}

.gallery-filter-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  width: 100%;
  justify-content: center;
}

.gallery-filter-title {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #1d1d1f;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  min-width: 70px;
  text-align: right;
}

.gallery-filter-chips-group {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.gallery-filter-link {
  display: inline-block;
  color: #86868b;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
  border-radius: 6px;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}
.gallery-filter-link:hover {
  color: #1d1d1f;
}
.gallery-filter-link.active {
  color: #007aff !important; 
  background-color: #f5f5f7;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
}

/* 🌟 [정밀 보정] 이미지 최소 폭을 기존 320px에서 2/3 수준인 215px로 전면 축소 */
.gallery-grid-zone {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(215px, 1fr)); 
  gap: 1.2rem; /* 카드가 작아진 만큼 격자 간격도 1.5rem에서 1.2rem으로 슬림화 */
  width: 100%;
  align-content: start;
}

/* 하마다 히데아키 스타일 프리미엄 이미지 마스크 */
.gallery-photo-card {
  position: relative;
  background: #f5f5f7;
  border-radius: 12px; /* 카드 크기에 맞춰 둥근 모서리 곡률도 미세하게 상향 조정 */
  overflow: hidden;
  cursor: pointer;
  aspect-ratio: 3 / 2;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.02);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.01);
  transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1);
}
.gallery-photo-card:hover {
  transform: scale(1.02); /* 작아진 카드 피드백 강도를 위해 스케일 핏 미세 조정 */
}

.gallery-card-img {
  width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center;
}

/* 마우스 오버 시 페이드인 오버레이 */
.gallery-hover-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.7) 100%);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 1rem;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
}
.gallery-photo-card:hover .gallery-hover-overlay {
  opacity: 1;
}

.gallery-hover-title {
  color: #ffffff; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 500; margin: auto 0 0 0;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
}

/* 라이트박스 확장 시네마 스튜디오 */
.lightbox-modal {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  z-index: 9999; display: none; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-sizing: border-box;
}

.lightbox-content-wrapper {
  max-width: 850px; width: 100%; height: 90vh;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; padding: 1rem; box-sizing: border-box; position: relative;
}

.lightbox-close-btn {
  position: absolute; top: 0.5rem; right: 1rem; font-size: 1.8rem; font-weight: 300; color: #1d1d1f; cursor: pointer; z-index: 10001; transition: transform 0.2s;
}
.lightbox-close-btn:hover { transform: scale(1.1); color: #ff3b30; }

.lightbox-main-stage { flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden; max-height: 55vh; }
.lightbox-expanded-img { max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; border-radius: 8px; }

.lightbox-meta-panel { text-align: left; margin-top: 1.5rem; border-top: 1px solid #e8e8ed; padding-top: 1.2rem; }
.lightbox-meta-date { font-size: 0.8rem; color: #86868b; margin-bottom: 0.2rem; }
.lightbox-meta-title { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; color: #1d1d1f; margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0; }
.lightbox-meta-desc { font-size: 0.95rem; color: #424245; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0 0 1rem 0; }

.lightbox-tag-chip {
  display: inline-block; border: 1px solid #e8e8ed; color: #86868b; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.7rem; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem; margin-right: 0.4rem;
}

.lightbox-thumb-rail {
  display: flex; gap: 0.6rem; overflow-x: auto; padding: 0.8rem 0; margin-top: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid #f5f5f7; width: 100%;
}
.lightbox-thumb-rail::-webkit-scrollbar { height: 4px; }
.lightbox-thumb-rail::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #e8e8ed; border-radius: 2px; }

.rail-thumb-node {
  width: 68px; height: 46px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; opacity: 0.4; transition: opacity 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; border: 2px solid transparent; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.rail-thumb-node:hover, .rail-thumb-node.active { opacity: 1; border-color: #007aff; }

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .gallery-filter-row { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.2rem; }
  .gallery-filter-title { text-align: left; min-width: auto; }
  .lightbox-content-wrapper { height: 95vh; }
  .lightbox-main-stage { max-height: 40vh; }
  .lightbox-meta-title { font-size: 1.2rem; }
}
</style>

<div class="gallery-filter-hero-container" id="gallerySidebar"></div>

<div class="gallery-grid-zone" id="galleryGrid">
  <p style="color: #86868b; text-align: center;">JSON 데이터 허브 결합 중...</p>
</div>

<div class="lightbox-modal" id="lightboxModal">
<div class="lightbox-content-wrapper">
<div class="lightbox-close-btn" id="lightboxClose">&times;</div>
<div class="lightbox-main-stage">
<img src="" class="lightbox-expanded-img" id="lightboxTargetImg" alt="Expanded Asset">
</div>
<div class="lightbox-meta-panel">
<div class="lightbox-meta-date" id="lightboxTargetDate"></div>
<h3 class="lightbox-meta-title" id="lightboxTargetTitle"></h3>
<p class="lightbox-meta-desc" id="lightboxTargetDesc"></p>
<div id="lightboxTargetTags"></div>
</div>
<div class="lightbox-thumb-rail" id="lightboxThumbRail"></div>
</div>
</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  const gridZone = document.getElementById('galleryGrid');
  const sidebarZone = document.getElementById('gallerySidebar');
  
  const modal = document.getElementById('lightboxModal');
  const closeBtn = document.getElementById('lightboxClose');
  const targetImg = document.getElementById('lightboxTargetImg');
  const targetTitle = document.getElementById('lightboxTargetTitle');
  const targetDate = document.getElementById('lightboxTargetDate');
  const targetDesc = document.getElementById('lightboxTargetDesc');
  const targetTags = document.getElementById('lightboxTargetTags');
  const thumbRail = document.getElementById('lightboxThumbRail');
  
  const activeFilters = { period: 'all', theme: 'all', camera: 'all' };
  let globalPhotoData = [];
  let currentRenderedData = [];
  let activeIndex = 0;

  fetch('gallery.json')
    .then(res => {
      if(!res.ok) throw new Error("데이터 파이프라인 결합 에러");
      return res.json();
    })
    .then(data => {
      globalPhotoData = data;
      buildEngine();
    })
    .catch(err => {
      gridZone.innerHTML = `<p style="color: #ff3b30; text-align: center;">자산 인입 오염: ${err.message}</p>`;
    });

  function buildEngine() {
    const periods = new Set();
    const themes = new Set();
    const cameras = new Set();

    globalPhotoData.forEach(item => {
      const yearStr = item.period ? item.period.substring(0, 4) : "Unknown";
      const yearVal = parseInt(yearStr);
      let decadeStr = "Unknown";
      
      if (!isNaN(yearVal)) {
        const decadeVal = Math.floor(yearVal / 10) * 10;
        decadeStr = decadeVal + "s";
        periods.add(decadeStr);
      } else {
        periods.add("Unknown");
      }

      const themeTheme = item.theme || "Unknown";
      const cameraCamera = item.camera || "Unknown";

      themes.add(themeTheme);
      cameras.add(cameraCamera);

      item.computed = { period: decadeStr, theme: themeTheme, camera: cameraCamera, rawPeriod: item.period || "Unknown" };
    });

    renderFilterBlock('Period', periods, 'period');
    renderFilterBlock('Theme', themes, 'theme');
    renderFilterBlock('Camera', cameras, 'camera');

    executeCrossFilter();
  }

  function renderFilterBlock(title, dataSet, filterKey) {
    const sorted = Array.from(dataSet).sort();
    if(filterKey === 'period') {
      sorted.sort((a, b) => b.localeCompare(a));
    }

    const rowBlock = document.createElement('div');
    rowBlock.className = 'gallery-filter-row';
    
    let html = `<div class="gallery-filter-title">${title}</div>`;
    html += `<div class="gallery-filter-chips-group">`;
    html += `<a href="#" class="gallery-filter-link active" data-key="${filterKey}" data-val="all">All</a>`;
    sorted.forEach(val => {
      html += `<a href="#" class="gallery-filter-link" data-key="${filterKey}" data-val="${val}">${val}</a>`;
    });
    html += `</div>`;
    
    rowBlock.innerHTML = html;
    sidebarZone.appendChild(rowBlock);

    rowBlock.querySelectorAll('.gallery-filter-link').forEach(link => {
      link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        rowBlock.querySelectorAll('.gallery-filter-link').forEach(l => l.classList.remove('active'));
        this.classList.add('active');

        activeFilters[filterKey] = this.getAttribute('data-val');
        executeCrossFilter();
      });
    });
  }

  function executeCrossFilter() {
    gridZone.innerHTML = '';
    
    currentRenderedData = globalPhotoData.filter(item => {
      const matchPeriod = (activeFilters.period === 'all') || (item.computed.period === activeFilters.period);
      const matchTheme = (activeFilters.theme === 'all') || (item.computed.theme === activeFilters.theme);
      const matchCamera = (activeFilters.camera === 'all') || (item.computed.camera === activeFilters.camera);
      return matchPeriod && matchTheme && matchCamera;
    });

    if(currentRenderedData.length === 0) {
      gridZone.innerHTML = `<p style="grid-column: span 3; color: #86868b; text-align: center; padding: 4rem 0;">조건에 매칭되는 사진 자산이 없습니다.</p>`;
      return;
    }

    currentRenderedData.forEach((item, index) => {
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.className = 'gallery-photo-card';
      
      card.innerHTML = `
        <img src="${item.image}" class="gallery-card-img" alt="${item.title}" loading="lazy">
        <div class="gallery-hover-overlay">
          <div class="gallery-hover-title">${item.title}</div>
        </div>
      `;
      
      card.addEventListener('click', () => {
        openLightbox(index);
      });

      gridZone.appendChild(card);
    });
  }

  function openLightbox(index) {
    activeIndex = index;
    modal.style.display = 'flex';
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    
    updateLightboxStage();
    buildThumbnailRail();
  }

  function updateLightboxStage() {
    const activeData = currentRenderedData[activeIndex];
    
    targetImg.src = activeData.image;
    targetTitle.innerText = activeData.title;
    targetDate.innerText = activeData.computed.rawPeriod;
    targetDesc.innerText = activeData.desc || '';
    
    targetTags.innerHTML = '';
    const chips = [activeData.computed.rawPeriod, activeData.computed.theme, activeData.computed.camera].filter(Boolean);
    chips.forEach(chip => {
      const span = document.createElement('span');
      span.className = 'lightbox-tag-chip';
      span.innerText = chip;
      targetTags.appendChild(span);
    });

    const thumbNodes = thumbRail.querySelectorAll('.rail-thumb-node');
    thumbNodes.forEach((node, idx) => {
      if(idx === activeIndex) {
        node.classList.add('active');
        node.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest', inline: 'center' });
      } else {
        node.classList.remove('active');
      }
    });
  }

  function buildThumbnailRail() {
    thumbRail.innerHTML = '';
    
    currentRenderedData.forEach((item, idx) => {
      const imgNode = document.createElement('img');
      imgNode.src = item.image;
      imgNode.className = 'rail-thumb-node';
      if(idx === activeIndex) imgNode.classList.add('active');
      
      imgNode.addEventListener('click', () => {
        activeIndex = idx;
        updateLightboxStage();
      });
      
      thumbRail.appendChild(imgNode);
    });
  }

  closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    modal.style.display = 'none';
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  });

  modal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if(e.target === modal) {
      modal.style.display = 'none';
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (modal.style.display === 'flex') {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        modal.style.display = 'none';
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
        if (activeIndex < currentRenderedData.length - 1) {
          activeIndex++;
          updateLightboxStage();
        }
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
        if (activeIndex > 0) {
          activeIndex--;
          updateLightboxStage();
        }
      }
    }
  });
});
</script>
```
